verdict.rationale: Abacum's planning docs say finance can 'update the plan without rebuilding it' by connecting actuals, assumptions, forecasts and scenarios in one workspace. They also describe budgeting and forecasting in one model fed by live ERP actuals, so numbers reflect 'today's, not last close's'. This covers the core of the story, but the evidence is marketing-level and never describes the re-baseline mechanics directly. Missing for 10: documented rolling-forecast or actuals-replace-forecast behavior after period close, any detail on how forecast baselines recalculate, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
